outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Lewis County precinct results, November 3, 2020 general. 'Lewis County Commissioner, District 1' and 'District 2' appear in all 96 precincts (commissioners elected county-wide in the general, RCW 36.32.040). 'PUD DISTRICT-AT-LARGE Commissioner District 1' and 'District 2' appear in 83 precincts: every precinct except CENTRALIA #1-#13 (the City of Centralia is outside Lewis County PUD No. 1).
